Pornește și compară sosirile la A, B și: Start and compare detections at A, B and C. Waves travel faster in deeper water. Over shelves and near the island, the front deforms; it reflects at coasts. Initial amplitude changes the level, not wave speed in this linear model.
Model liniar de unde lungi: fund fix, de: Linear long-wave model: fixed bottom, displacements small compared with depth. Coasts are impermeable; the top and bottom edges gradually absorb waves. Inundation, breaking and beach wave height are not calculated.
Sursa este o ridicare inițială netedă a: The source is a smooth initial uplift of water with zero initial velocity. It does not reproduce a historical earthquake. Colours highlight small displacements; their scale stays fixed during a run. Changing the source or amplitude restarts the experiment; time acceleration does not change the physics.
Bazin: 1200 × 720 km. Adâncimi: 100–4000: Basin: 1200 × 720 km. Depths: 100–4000 m. Maximum duration: 3 simulated hours. Calculations use linear shallow-water equations; results are educational, not forecasts for real coasts.
